newsitem.title: USA: Kodak, Motorola in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Kodak, Motorola in joint venture.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co and Motorola Inc's semiconductor products sector said they are working together to develop Advanced CMOS Imager technology for use in the digital imaging marketplace.
Under the venture, they will combine Motorola's manufacturing and semiconductor integration capabilities with Kodak's technology expertise in digital imaging products to develop CMOS sensors.
CMOS, or Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor, is a high performance, low power manufacturing process with integration capabilities that make it ideal for low cost, high volume digital circuits.

"The ability to integrate vision capability with mainstream CMOS manufacturing will add a new dimension and excitement to the way people communicate -- beyond voice and data to transporting information through images," Motorola Semiconductor Products Sector President Hector Ruiz said in a statement.
